items.title: Food Pro Vs Noob
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Food isn't just sustenance or a good tasting snack! It's a lifestyle! Are you a food pro?

- 8 roleplay skins!
- Foodie cosplay attire inspired by food!

items.title: Ultimate Anime
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
The ultimate anime cosplays and vibes are here! Become your favorite anime character and live out a new story of your own in their shoes. Literally!

- 12 roleplay skins!
- Diverse cosplay attire inspired by popular fiction series!

items.title: Sky Force
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Let's fly! Fly above the clouds in the sky! Feel the wind stream beside you! Zoom across the world! That's what it means to be a part of Sky Force!

- 12 roleplay skins!
- Airline pilot attire inspired by aircraft!

items.title: Shades
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Get your favorite trendy hoodies in greyscale! With different styles to choose from, there's sure to be a perfect black & white hoodie for you!

+ 12 custom skins for you to choose from!
+ A black & white hoodie for every person!

items.title: Fancy Mobs
items.creator: Impulse
items.description: These mobs are all dressed up and ready for a night out! Look dashing as you traverse your Minecraft world as your favorite mob dressed in a fancy suit. With 12 skins to choose from, you're sure to find one perfect for you!

items.title: Emo Anime Teens
items.creator: Glowfischdesigns
items.description:
They are spooky they are awesome and they do it in style.
Demons, masks, dragons and more. We have it all just pick it up now!
What more could you ask for?

+ 2 free emo teens.
+ 10 epic skins!

items.title: Isle of Draco
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Shipwrecked and lost on a strange new island. Can you survive the island's terrible and hidden secrets?
Explore this beautiful island and the temples that lay scattered around it. 

-Roleplay as a shipwrecked survivor and conquer the new island you find yourself on.
-3 temples to explore.
-Custom terrain
-Awesome volcano

items.title: Simple Spawns Battle Base
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Conquer this base on top of a mesa. It's nearly impenetrable! A great location to secure, contain and protect. The surrounding environment will be tricky for your opponents to navigate. You will always have the upper hand!

+ A fortified base with a high vantage point
+ Perfect for SCP
+ RP on your own or play with friends!

items.title: Neon vs Pastel Fashion 2
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
We need your help to battle out which side is the best, team neon or team pastel! Choose between 32 modern skins that have 16 edgy skins that glow so bright it makes everything shine, and 16 cute pastel skins that makes everyone fall for your soft teen kawaii looks. 

- 32 trendy skins
- Includes 2 free skins

items.title: Zombie Arena
items.creator: Cyclone
items.description:
Get ready to shred some metal, kick some butt and look cool while doing it in the Zombie Arena. Face off against waves of unique zombies with lots of amazing weapons. Explosives on a Sledgehammer? Sure! A lightning guitar? We got it! Find your style and show 'em what you're made of.

+ 23 new Zombie Mobs
+ 6 custom 3D Weapons
+ 45 arena wave fights with custom music

items.title: Space Station Life
items.creator: Kreatik Studios
items.description:
Are you a fan of sci-fi yet crave for that unique survival experience in space? Put your astronaut suit on, pilot the space shuttle to the nearest planet and feel the loss of gravity. 

+ Pilot a space shuttle vehicle yourself!
+ Explore the space station and many planets such as Earth and Saturnus
+ Multiplayer compatible
+ Free skin

By Kreatik Studios

items.title: Neon Peace Officers
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Want to help your neighbors out? Now's your chance to suit up and be the that friendly neighborhood public servant! With many uniforms to choose from, this skin pack features plenty of colorful designs and options for any task!

- Includes 8 HD skins with male and female options!
- Each skin features unique, matching accessories
- By SmartPixel & Pathway Studios

items.title: Medieval Life
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
This amazing skin pack will take you back in time with 20 awesome looking medieval-themed skins. Create incredible medieval worlds with your friends and tell a captivating story while rocking one of these outfits!

- 20 medieval-themed skins (monsters included!)
- By Varuna and Pathway Studios

items.title: Demons Space Collection
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
If you thought running into creatures in the Nether was the worst of your problems, think again. With this skin pack featuring the latest space suit tech, demons now float around every corner of the universe, and you can be one of them!

- Includes 8 HD skins
- Each space suit is unique in design and color
- By SmartPixel & Pathway Studios

items.title: The Alchemist: Desert Survival
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Stuck in the the scorching desert, it's time once again to master the art of alchemy to craft items, build machines, and survive. Using a unique crafting system, create almost anything from nothing!

- New recipes and multi-block machines to survive the lethal desert temperatures.
- Discover electricity and automate your alchemy!
- By TheRedEngineer & Pathway Studios

items.title: Cute Space Suits
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Cute colorful teen astronauts love to float around in space. If you love role-playing in space suits or need a new suit to put on in your space ship then these skins are for you!

- 8 skins

items.title: Become a Creeper
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Become a creeper with exploding poop! Startling transformations await you, from human to pig to tall pig and finally to the creeper. Use your creeper poop to blow up anything you want.
- Mine, craft, and poop as a creeper
- Pigs, cows, and sheep are stretched tall and wide
- Multiplayer fun
- 5 skins

The poop explodes!

items.title: Lava Rises Every Minute
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Play the most dangerous Skyblock world ever devised! Start at the bottom of a volcano and build your way above the rising pool of lava. Slay hidden boss golems and use their loot to save the world from a catastrophe.
- New boss mob: Lava Golem
- Boss gains new moves as lava increases
- A unique skyblock challenge to test your abilities

Don't look down!

items.title: Royal Mobs
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: These royal mobs now have the fanciest crowns in all the land! Rule with an iron sword, or better yet, a diamond sword!

items.title: Abstract Mobs
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
Time for you to look retro and interesting! Which pixel abstract will you choose?
These skins are perfect for your mob adventures!

items.title: I Love K-Pop
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Stand out from the crowd with these amazing k-pop skins.
One free skin!

items.title: Fashion Ninjas
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
The new trend to look like a ninja is at its dawn. Join the game as shinobi and become the most popular sneak arts master! Choose wisely between unique skins.

+ Anime
+ Shinobi look
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Teen Fashion Buddies 2
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Have you ever wanted to be a teen fashion model? With this new skin pack, you will be able to play as top models from all around the globe. Join the game with your outstanding look and show a true teen fashion style.

+ Anime style
+ Stunning looks
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Mob Fashion 2 Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
These trendy teens are back at it again with fashionable hoodies and cool beanies. Dress up as an animal mob and be one amongst the herd! This pack offers costumes for chicken, sheep, cow, and more. 

+ 14 skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna
